paite: Huan Jeriko zawn Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Levite Khopi Sehte
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, agam uah Levite tenna ding khuate bawlsak uhen. Agante uh tatna ding in kho dainawl kim Levite na piak ding uh ahi.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

paite: Khuate atenna ding uh ahi dia, akimte bel bawng leh agante leh aganvulh tengteng a ding ahi.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

paite: Levite na piak ding dainawl khokulh a pan tong sangkhat a sau ahih ding ahi.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

paite: Kulh polam a pan na teh dia, suahlam pang ah tong sangnih, mallam pang ah tong sangnih, khopi bel alaitak ah a-om ding ahi. Hiai amau dainawl tuam ahi ding.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khuate lak ah tualthatte taina ding kihumbitna khopi guk ahi dia; huaite lou khua sawmli-le-nih na piak lai ding uh ahi.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khua tengteng khua sawmli-le-giat ahi ding. Dainawl toh na piak ding uh ahi.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

paite: Israel suante luah khua na piakdan ding, mi tamte na pe tam dia, atawmte na pe tawm ding ahi. Michih in aluah uh gam tamdan dungzui a khua Levite na piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Kihumbitna Khopite / (Diu 19.1-13; Jos 20.1-9)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: Jordan lui na galkah ua Kanaan gam na lut chiang un kihumbitna khua na sep ding uh ahi, tup mawng hilou a tual thatkhami taina ding in.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: Huai khuate, phulami a pan na kihumbitna khua uh, omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma a tualthatmi asihlouhna ding ahi.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

paite: Nou a dia kihumbitna ding na sehte uh khopi guk ahi ding.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

paite: Jordan gal ah khopi thum na sep dingua, Kanaan gam ah khopi thum na sep ding ua, kihumbitna khopite ahi ding uh.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

paite: Israel suante leh namdang leh akiang ua tengte a ding in hiai khopi gukte kihumbitna ahi dia, huai ah kuapeuh mi that kha atailut ding ahi.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: "Himahleh mi kuahiam in sik a mi asat a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Si khop a suang a mi aden a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Ahihkeileh mi khat in mi khat sing zang in sat henla, si taleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Sisan phulami'n tualthatmi athat dia, amuh peuh chiang in athat ding ahi.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

paite: "Mi khatpeuh in huatna toh tupkholhna nei in midang khat sawn henla, ahihkeileh tup mawng in banghiam in deng henla, huai mi si taleh;
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

paite: ahihkeileh kimelmakna nei in akhuttum in tum henla, huai mi si taleh ahihlumpa hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Amah tualthat ahi a, sisan phulami in athah ding ahi.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

paite: "Himahleh kimelmakna nei hilou a, kuahiam khat in midang asawn khak ahihkeileh tup mawng hilou a amah aden khak a,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

paite: ahihkeileh amah mu lou a, amah that thei suang atung a akhiak a, amah asihleh amelma leng hilou a, hihnat tum leng hilou ahih ziak in.
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

paite: Omkhawmte'n hiai vaihawmna dan bang in ahihlum mi leh sisan phulami vai ahawmsak ding uh ahi:
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

paite: Omkhawmte'n tualthatmi sisan phulami a pan ahumbit ding ua, omkhawmte'n ataina, akihumbitna khua ah atengsak ding ua, sathau siangthou nilh a om siampu lianpen asih mateng huai lai khua ah ateng ding hi.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

paite: Himahleh chik lai peuh in tualthatmi ataina, a kihumbitna kho gamgi polam apai a;
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

paite: sisan phulami in akihumbitna kho polam a amuh a, sisan phulami in athahleh asisan ah moh apo kei ding.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

paite: Siampu lian asih mateng akihumbitna khua ah ateng gige ding a, himahleh siampu asih in bel tualthatmi atenna gam ah apaikik ding ahi.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

paite: Hiai thilte na suante uh tan a na tenna peuh ua na vaihawmna dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: "Kuapeuh in mi athahleh tualthatmi pen theihpihte kam a pan thupawt a hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia mi hihlupna ding in ahun kei.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

paite: Tualthatmi na tan ding uh ahi kei. Sihna khop a moh ahi a, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi zaw.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

paite: Siampu sih ma in, kihumbitna khua a tailut kuapeuh agam a sawlkik nawn dia tatna sum na lak ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

paite: Huchi in na tenna gam uh na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, sisan in gam ahihthanghuaileh sisan suahna gam hihthanghuai silna ding in asuahmi sisan kia lou lah zattheih ahi ngal kei a.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

paite: Na tenna gam uh, ka omna na hihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
